Questions

Things you might be wondering.

What is PlanStudy?

PlanStudy is an AI study planner. It turns your subjects, deadlines and class timetable into a day-by-day plan you can follow, on your phone or laptop.

When will it launch?

We are still building. Everyone on the waitlist hears first, by email, as soon as it is ready for you.

How much will it cost?

PlanStudy is free to use.

Do I need an internet connection?

No. PlanStudy keeps working with no connection, so your timetable and plan are always there when you need them.

Does it work on my phone and my laptop?

Yes. PlanStudy is made for both phones and laptops.

What do you do with my email address?

We use it only to tell you when PlanStudy is ready. We will not sell it.
